description:
The Ultimate Nashville Bachelorette Buyout – Last Rodeo Suites 2 & 3

Your dream bachelorette weekend just got even better. Book both Last Rodeo Suite 2 and Last Rodeo Suite 3 for an exclusive 8-bedroom, 6-bathroom private retreat, just five minutes from Broadway’s neon lights and live music scene. Designed with your squad in mind, this buyout offers double the space, double the fun, and endless picture-worthy moments.

The space
Why You’ll Love It:
- Two Glam Rooms – Get party-ready in style with dedicated spaces for hair, makeup, and pre-night-out selfies.
- Two Spacious Living Areas + Bonus Lounges – Plenty of room for group hangs, rom-com marathons, and post-Broadway wind-downs.
- Two Fully Equipped Kitchens – Stock up on bubbly, whip up brunch, and toast to the bride-to-be.
- Private Balcony with Skyline Views – Sip cocktails with your crew as you take in the twinkling Nashville skyline.
- Playful, Chic, and Feminine Decor – The perfect backdrop for all your bachelorette festivities.

The Space:
With eight beautifully designed bedrooms, including two bunk rooms, there’s space for everyone to relax and recharge. Multiple ensuite bathrooms ensure no one is waiting too long to freshen up, while the open-concept living areas and kitchens make group dining and celebrations seamless.

Sleeping Arrangements:
- Two Primary Suites – Luxe escapes with ensuite bathrooms.
- Six Additional Bedrooms – Stylish, comfortable, and perfect for your squad.
- Two Bonus Bunk Rooms – Slumber party dreams come true.

Your Bachelorette Itinerary Starts Here:
- Morning coffee on your private balconies
- Honky-tonk afternoons just minutes away on Broadway
- Golden hour rooftop photos with the skyline as your backdrop
- Pre-party glam in the dedicated Glam Rooms
- Late-night memories in Nashville’s hottest spots
- Cozy wind-downs in chic, pink-hued lounges

Whether you’re here for the rooftop cocktails, honky-tonk nights, or - an unforgettable girls’ getaway, The Last Rodeo Suites Buyout is the ultimate Nashville bachelorette experience.

Book now and give your bride the bachelorette bash of a lifetime.

There’s a reason Nashville, TN has become one of the country’s most loved southern cities. With its vibrant nightlife, country music scene, and incredible food, “Nashvegas” is a top destination for people simply looking to have a good time- which means lots of drinking and eating. Visitors flock to Broadway, a street lined with multi-level bars playing live music and serving bbq. You might get stuck in traffic behind party bikes called Pedal Taverns, but you’re more likely to cheer them on than get road rage because having fun is part of the culture in Nashville.

Nearby attractions: Broadway, Nashville Farmer’s Market, Ryman Auditorium, Honky Tonk, Bridgestone Arena, Centennial Park, Monell’s (Southern), Rolf and Daughters (Italian), Henrietta Red (Seafood), O-ku (Sushi).

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.
